scope: Review of conservative calibration versus the v0.9 symmetric source gate; no new template scoring or validation draws
change_reason: A lower-content tolerance calibration does not target equality to nominal coverage. Separate minimum-coverage qualification from interval usefulness and retain overcoverage as a diagnostic.

qualification.coverage_bound: One-sided exact binomial Clopper-Pearson lower limit: 0 for h=0, otherwise beta.ppf(0.05/144, h, n-h+1), with all attempted draws in n
qualification.coverage_requirement: Every declared cell has lower confidence bound >=0.93; no upper-coverage veto
qualification.usefulness_requirement: Every declared control has finite well-defined confidence components and empirical median outer span <=0.25; retain total length, span tails and disconnected frequencies
qualification.failures: Unresolved fits/intervals are noncoverage; at most 10/1000. Bias and widths retain successful-fit denominators.
qualification.interpretation: New Monte Carlo qualification of a 93% minimum on the fixed 144-cell common-law control grid, conditional on empirical modelling laws and independently fixed cutoffs. Not exact 95% coverage, universal generator validity, conditional disjoint-pool coverage or a simultaneous physics-performance claim.
qualification.error_budget_scope: The 0.05 calibration-family error and 0.05 validation-qualification error are distinct; do not combine them into an unproved joint 95% guarantee. Failure/span ceilings remain empirical criteria, not simultaneous population confidence bounds.
